name: implicit two-frame Sprite states
lua_assertions:
native_sprite:Load("crates/deadsync-noteskin/tests/fixtures/implicit-animation/Down Tap Explosion 2x1.png")
assert(native_sprite:GetNumStates()==2)
assert(math.abs(native_sprite:GetAnimationLengthSeconds()-0.2)<0.000001)
native_sprite:SetSecondsIntoAnimation(0.0); assert(native_sprite:GetState()==0, "frame at 0.0")
native_sprite:SetSecondsIntoAnimation(0.05); assert(native_sprite:GetState()==0, "frame at 0.05")
native_sprite:SetSecondsIntoAnimation(0.1); assert(native_sprite:GetState()==1, "frame at 0.1")
native_sprite:SetSecondsIntoAnimation(0.15); assert(native_sprite:GetState()==1, "frame at 0.15")
native_sprite:SetSecondsIntoAnimation(0.2); assert(native_sprite:GetState()==0, "frame at 0.2")
native_sprite:SetSecondsIntoAnimation(0.35); assert(native_sprite:GetState()==1, "frame at 0.35")
native_sprite:SetSecondsIntoAnimation(0.15)
native_sprite:diffusealpha(1):zoom(0.65):linear(0.22):zoom(1.4):diffusealpha(0)
assert(native_sprite:GetState()==1, "hit tween preserves the sprite state")
native_sprite:setstate(0)
assert(native_sprite:GetState()==0, "explicit hit seek resets the sprite state")
